SRT Generator AI — Initial Release

- Generate SRT subtitle files from video or audio, supporting easy uploads and quick downloads.
- Automatic session setup with anonymous token support (no manual config needed).
- Handles uploads, downloads, credits, export, and editing via cloud API.
- Supports multiple file formats (mp4, mov, avi, wav, etc) up to 500MB.
- Job queueing and GPU-accelerated rendering; typical jobs complete in 30-90 seconds.
- Built-in error handling for common failure cases (file type, token, credit, etc).
